name: Fifty | Fifty
kurzbeschreibung:
**Fifty | Fifty in Vomp**

Discover the **Fifty** experience in the heart of the **Zillertal** – where adventure meets relaxation. Just a short drive from **Innsbruck**, the **Fifty** adventure park in **Vomp** offers an unforgettable day for the whole family.

**Thrilling rides** await you on the **Fifty** high ropes course, where you can conquer **15 different challenges** at heights of up to **25 meters**. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced adventurer, the **Fifty** course has something for everyone.

After the adrenaline rush, unwind in the cozy **Fifty Lounge** with a refreshing drink and enjoy the stunning views of the **Zillertal Alps**. For a hearty meal, try the **Kaiserschmarrn** or a traditional **Tiroler Gröstl** at the **Fifty Restaurant**.

In the evening, the **Fifty** area transforms into a magical world with a **fire show** and live music. End your day with a warm **Glühwein** or a cold **Radler** by the campfire.

**Fifty in Vomp** – where every visit is an adventure!
